chain.title: Muscle Before Machines
chain.desc: A heavy weighted pressure plate over iron ingots; it beats ingots into plates, rods and dust with no power at all.

chain.title: Three Copper, One Tin
chain.desc: Smelt bronze dust, itself a shapeless mix of three copper dust and one tin dust hammered out on the forge hammer.

chain.title: The Bronze Age Begins
chain.desc: Eight bronze plates ringed around a single bronze gear.

chain.title: Kettle Under Pressure
chain.desc: Bronze plates and a bronze tank over a furnace and three fire clay bricks; it burns fuel into steam.

chain.title: Steam-Driven Teeth
chain.desc: Two diamonds, copper gears and fluid pipes bolted to a bronze machine casing to double ore into dust.

chain.title: Baking the Black Rock
chain.desc: A furnace ringed with eight vanilla bricks; it bakes coal into coke and creosote.

chain.title: Fire Clay Crucible
chain.desc: A vanilla blast furnace ringed with eight fire clay bricks.

chain.title: Seven Iron, Two Coke
chain.desc: Mix seven iron dust with two coke dust into uncooked steel dust, then fire it down to steel.

chain.title: Tier Two by Hand
chain.desc: Bronze rods, bronze gears, a bronze rotor and fire clay bricks around a steel machine casing; right-click it onto a bronze machine.

chain.title: First Circuit Board
chain.desc: A resistor, an inductor, capacitors and copper wire pressed onto an analog circuit board.

chain.title: LV Hull
chain.desc: An analog circuit over redstone batteries, a steel machine casing and tin cables.

chain.title: Steam Becomes Current
chain.desc: Fluid pipes, tin rotors and motors with an analog circuit on a basic machine hull; it turns steam into EU.

chain.title: The Furnace That Never Cools
chain.desc: A vanilla blast furnace and a basic machine hull wrapped in cupronickel magnetic wire.

chain.title: Hands That Never Tire
chain.desc: Robot arms and conveyors with analog circuits fitted to a basic machine hull.

chain.title: MV Logic
chain.desc: Diodes and transistors laid over analog circuits on an electronic circuit board.

chain.title: MV Hull
chain.desc: An electronic circuit over silicon batteries and an advanced machine casing.

chain.title: HV Logic
chain.desc: OR, NOT and AND gates set among electronic circuits on a digital circuit board.

chain.title: HV Hull
chain.desc: A digital circuit over sodium batteries and a turbo machine casing.

chain.title: EV Logic
chain.desc: Digital circuits, random access memory and a memory management unit on a processing unit board.

chain.title: EV Hull
chain.desc: A processing unit over cadmium batteries and a highly advanced machine casing.

chain.title: Controlled Chain Reaction
chain.desc: Nuclear alloy large plates, processing units and cadmium control rods around a highly advanced machine hull.

chain.title: Quantum Hull
chain.desc: A quantum circuit over plutonium batteries and a quantum machine casing.

chain.title: Ignition
chain.desc: Eight fusion chambers and quantum circuits assembled around a quantum machine hull.

chain.title: Everything, Compressed
chain.desc: Implosion-compressed from an ultradense metal ball and sixty-four nukes; electrolyzing it yields UU matter.

notes: Verified against the Fabric build of Modern Industrialization 1.8.6 for 1.20.1 (the only 1.20.1 build published on Modrinth; ids are loader-independent). IMPORTANT: MI's machine block items have NO assets/modern_industrialization/models/item/*.json file - their models are generated at runtime - so a strict models-and-lang intersection drops every machine. Verification therefore used (models AND lang) OR (lang AND referenced inside data/modern_industrialization/**); every machine id listed here was additionally confirmed to appear as a recipe RESULT in data/modern_industrialization/recipes/**. Tiering is strict and was read from the recipe folder names themselves: steam_age/bronze -> steam_age/steel -> electric_age (hull LV/MV/HV/EV/quantum) -> nuclear and fusion. Note 'quarry' does not exist as an id; the machines are steam_quarry and electric_quarry. Nothing was dropped: every id listed passed the membership check.
